query: SELECT COALESCE(b.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND b.actor=$2 AND (b.job_id IS NULL OR b.grant_generation=(SELECT grant_generation FROM push_jobs WHERE id=b.job_id)) AND (f.result IS NULL OR COALESCE((f.result->>'prepared')::boolean,false)) AND ((b.token_jti=$2 AND b.shared_generation IS NULL) OR b.shared_generation=$3),false) AS "authorized!", b.work_id,COALESCE(b.work_id=$4 AND b.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND b.expires_at>clock_timestamp(),false) AS "claimed!" FROM upload_finalizations f JOIN upload_finalization_batches b ON b.id=f.batch_id WHERE f.session_id=$1 FOR SHARE OF b
